title: Scheduled BLS Employment Situation release-day full-UTC-day BTC risk veto
thesis: The complete UTC day containing a preregistered BLS Employment Situation release may have worse BTC return and path risk than same-window non-event days with the same weekdays because a labor-market update can reprice expected policy, growth and cross-asset liquidity.
mechanism: A calendar-known Employment Situation release concentrates uncertainty around an 08:30 Eastern information shock, which may increase downside incidence or intraday drawdown in BTC even though payroll, unemployment, earnings and revision surprise directions are unknown and an adversarial Bitcoin-macro prior predicts muted or unstable responses.
economic_rationale: A spot-only policy that exits BTC at 00:00 UTC on each frozen Employment Situation release date and reenters at the next 00:00 UTC is useful only if avoided event-day losses and drawdown exceed two fee-and-adverse-slippage transitions per event and the opportunity cost of foregone positive event-day returns under matched capital.
